column3: NASB reads “Hiram” for the Hebrew written “Huram”; “craftsmen of a wall” is rendered “masons,” and “craftsmen of wood” as “carpenters.” NASB adds “with.”
“The ones born who belonged to him” is rendered “the children born to him.”
“To seek David” is rendered “in search of David”; “went out before them” is rendered “went out against them,” and NASB supplies “of it.”
“The valley of the Rephaites” is rendered “the valley of Rephaim.”
“Go up and I will give” is rendered “Go up, for I will give.”
“They went up at Baal Perazim” is rendered “they came up to”; “burst out” is rendered “broken through,” and “like a bursting out of water” as “like the breakthrough of waters.”
“David spoke” is rendered “David gave the order.”
“Repeated again” is rendered “made yet another raid.”
“Go around from on them” is rendered “circle around behind them.”
“Camp” is rendered “army,” and NASB adds “even as far as.”
“The name of David” is rendered “the fame of David,” and “put” as “brought.”
